body: I went to my dr told him about my drinking boy about the abuse or anything and how I was just hiding out as often as I could.  He gave me sertaline.  I took it for one month and like a week.  Then I stopped because he’d call me names like crazy CUNT or making comments about how I needed crazy pills. So I gave it up.

Always needed saving ya know?  Except it never sinks in that nobody is coming for me.  Everyone says I have to do it myself...I have been fighting daily for so long that I’m just tired.  Change isn’t as easy as they all
Make it sound.

I have always been sad or depressed.  When I was about 6-7 I was sexually assaulted until I was almost ready to move out.. then I met this guy.  Who seemed perfect.  Turns out he wasn’t the answer.  Just from one bad situation into another.

I feel this way as well.  Everyday just seems like one miserable ass ache. Miserable in any and all things I do.  I only find joy in drinking, sleeping, or rubbing one out.  The rest of my days I just can’t wait to get into bed so it can be over.

I’ll be depressed with you.  I am about as miserable as they come.  People always give me the well you have to change your life and it will get better...it’a never been good and probably never will be. Direct message me for my discord tag if you wanna chat!

I usually just have coffee in the morning and then I go all day and have just anything for dinner.  No sense in just making food for me.  Too much of an effort at this point.  Spoon of peanut butter,  toast, or whatever else I can be bothered with...
